name: FCC Filing Leaks Regarding Switch 2 Pro Controller Audio Jack
title: Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller FCC Filing Leaks? Headphone Jack Potentially Added
body: A new FCC filing under model number BEE-008 has appeared in regulatory databases, revealing details for an unannounced Nintendo game controller. Testing documentation confirms Bluetooth and NFC connectivity alongside testing with wired 3.5mm earbuds, leading to speculation that Nintendo plans to add an audio jack to the Switch 2 Pro Controller.
description: Составлен по заголовку статьи TOY PEOPLE и материалам FCC-заявки BEE-008 (оригинал статьи на toy-people.com на традиционном китайском за Cloudflare 403)

name: Patent Filing For Hybrid Controller Attachment
title: Nintendo Patents Magnetic Controller Attachment Mechanism For Hybrid Gaming Device
body: A recently surfaced patent application from Nintendo outlines an alternative magnetic locking mechanism for detachable side controllers on a portable console. The diagrams detail magnetic contact pins and alignment grooves designed to secure peripheral devices during handheld play.

name: Retailer Leak On Unannounced Future Zelda Expansion
title: Retailer leak points to Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Complete Edition with unreleased story DLC for 2027
body: A prominent European retail database has briefly listed an unannounced Complete Edition of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom scheduled for mid-2027. According to the listing, the package includes the base game enhanced for Switch 2 alongside a brand-new story expansion featuring the sealing war era.

name: Switch 2 System Firmware 2.1.0 Update Notes
title: Nintendo Switch 2 System Update 2.1.0 improves DLSS stability and 120Hz VRR output in dock mode
body: Nintendo has deployed system firmware version 2.1.0 for Nintendo Switch 2 worldwide. The official patch notes detail improved handshake stability with 120Hz VRR television displays when docked, reduced frame pacing jitter in backward compatible titles running with DLSS upscaling, and overall system security improvements.

name: Anonymous Insider Leak On Next Smash Bros Project
title: Rumor: Next Super Smash Bros. entering early production with external partner studio
body: According to an anonymous industry insider with a track record of accurate fighting game leaks, pre-production on the next installment in the Super Smash Bros. franchise has officially begun. The report claims Masahiro Sakurai is serving as a creative supervisor while day-to-day development is co-handled by Bandai Namco Studios.

name: GameChat Developer Interview On R&D History
title: Nintendo reveals GameChat origins including Switch 1 prototype, started working on Switch 2 features in 2020
body: In an official interview published this week, Nintendo hardware and software developers revealed the origins of the GameChat system, explaining that early prototypes were tested during the original Switch era and development of new networking features for Switch 2 began back in 2020.

name: Nintendo Museum Special Zelda Retrospective
title: Nintendo Museum announces special Zelda retrospective exhibition and exclusive hardware showcase
body: Nintendo has announced its first major special exhibition for the Nintendo Museum in Kyoto, focusing on the evolution of The Legend of Zelda with rare development materials and playable prototypes.

name: Metroid Prime 4 In-Depth Gameplay Showcase
title: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond receives extensive new gameplay overview and performance breakdown
body: Nintendo has released an in-depth gameplay overview showcasing new traversal abilities, environmental scanning, and visual enhancements running at a rock-solid 60 FPS.
